title: Optimal Estimation of Large-Dimensional Nonlinear Factor Models
abstract: arXiv:2311.07243v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper studies optimal estimation of large-dimensional nonlinear factor models. The key challenge is that the observed variables are possibly nonlinear functions of some latent variables, with the functional forms left unspecified. A local principal component analysis method combining K-nearest neighbors matching and principal component analysis is proposed to estimate the factor structure and recover information on latent variables and latent functions. Large-sample properties are established, including a sharp bound on the matching discrepancy of nearest neighbors, sup-norm error bounds for estimated local factors and factor loadings, and the uniform convergence rate of the factor structure estimator. Under mild conditions our estimator of the latent factor structure can achieve the optimal rate of uniform convergence for nonparametric regression. translated_title: 大维非线性因子模型的最优估计
translated_abstract: 本文研究大维非线性因子模型的最优估计问题。其核心挑战在于观测变量可能是某些潜变量的非线性函数，且函数形式未预先设定。本文提出了一种结合K近邻匹配与主成分分析的局部主成分分析方法，用于估计因子结构并恢复潜变量和潜函数的相关信息。文章建立了大样本性质，包括最近邻匹配差异的精确界、估计的局部因子与因子载荷的上确界范数误差界，以及因子结构估计量的一致收敛速度。在温和条件下，所提出的潜因子结构估计量可以达到非参数回归最优的一致收敛速度。该方法通过蒙特卡洛实验和实证应用加以说明。
tldr: 本文提出一种结合K近邻匹配与主成分分析的局部主成分分析方法，实现了大维非线性因子模型的最优估计，并在温和条件下达到非参数回归最优的一致收敛速度。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a local principal component analysis method combining K-nearest neighbors matching and PCA to optimally estimate large-dimensional nonlinear factor models, achieving the optimal uniform convergence rate for nonparametric regression under mild conditions.
